For my website design project, I decided to approach Super Save Supermarkets because I have an evening job at the supermarket, so I already have a slight insight into their organizational goals and workings.
The field research for my project was in two stages.
First, I had an interview with Mr. Dunn, who is in charge of SuperSaves Customer Care Department.
I discussed the project with him in order to identify the supermarket's
Mr Dunn said customers are often unwilling to make a face-to-face complaint when they've experienced difficulties with a product or a member of staff or anything related to the supermarket.
So he said a website which allowed members of the public to get in touch with the organization and bring the problem to their attention in a
manner might be very useful.

towards making complaints.

I visited four super safe stores, two in the city centre and two in the outskirts and all together I interviewed 101 respondents.
Then finally, I analyze the results.
We found the results of the questionnaires to be very informative.
I found that out of the total number of customers investigated, 64% had at some stage encountered a problem in a super safe store.
Out of these people, the vast majority said that they hadn't reported the problem to any member of staff.
but they just kept it to themselves.
The next thing I tried to find out was why they hadn't complained.
Well, about 25% of the people I interviewed said the reason was that they couldn't be bothered.
and a slightly smaller percentage so that they didn't have enough time.
But 55% said the reason was that they felt intimidated.
I finally asked if they would be more likely to complain if they didn't have to do it face to face.

95% to be exact.
